prompt: I just dropped the new Extensiv creds into the env file. Can you check that the connection actually works and tell me what environment you're pointed at?
rationale: First thing to run after configuring credentials: auth, token expiry, base URL/environment label, scope, writes flag. Nothing else answers 'does the connection work'.

prompt: Which customers and warehouses are you allowed to see, and are you allowed to change anything for any of them?
rationale: Question is about the server's read/write scope and write policy, which is exactly describe_scope. verify_connection reports counts, not the list.

prompt: Pull up Acme Outdoor Co's open orders that were created last week. Just the short list, I don't need every line item.
rationale: Search by customer + status + created date range with compact summaries is find_orders. find_stuck_orders would add an exception filter the user did not ask for.

prompt: What's going on with ACME-SO-10007? Did it ship, and if so what's the tracking number?
rationale: One order by reference number, needs status, packages and tracking numbers: get_order_status returns all of it in one call.

prompt: anything stuck for acme? orders that have been sitting open more than 3 days or that we can't fill
rationale: 'Stuck', 'sitting open more than N days', 'can't fill' (short on inventory) are the exception filters find_stuck_orders exists for.

prompt: How many ACME-TENT-2P do we have available for Acme Outdoor Co at LAX-1 right now, and is any of it on hold or expiring?
rationale: Stock position (available / on hold / lots and expiry) for a SKU at a customer + facility is check_inventory. lookup_item would only return the item master.

prompt: Is ACME-FILTER-SQZ lot tracked? And what are its carton dims and weight, the carrier is asking.
rationale: Item master attributes (lot/serial/expiry tracking, dims, weight, UOM) live on the item record, so lookup_item, not check_inventory.

prompt: Do we have any inbound for Acme expected this week? Specifically looking for their PO-ACME-2204.
rationale: Inbound receipts/ASNs filtered by customer, PO number and expected date range is find_receipts.

prompt: Receipt ACME-ASN-5003 for Acme came in last week. What did we actually receive vs what the ASN said, line by line? The customer says they're short 40 tents.
rationale: Single receipt in depth with expected vs received per line and variances is get_receipt_status.

prompt: Give me today's rundown for Acme at LAX-1: what got created, shipped, cancelled, anything on hold, and what inbound closed.
rationale: A one-shot daily snapshot across orders, receipts and exceptions for a customer/facility is operations_summary; assembling it from find_orders + find_receipts is the wrong first call.

prompt: What shipped for Acme in the last two hours according to the webhook feed? I want the OrderConfirm events, not a search.
rationale: The user explicitly asks for ingested webhook events filtered by type/customer/since, which is recent_events, not find_orders.

prompt: Set up an order for Acme Outdoor Co out of LAX-1: ref ACME-SO-10101, 2 x ACME-TENT-2P and 1 x ACME-STOVE-01, ship to Jane Doe, 123 Main St, Boise ID 83702, UPS Ground. Show me what it'll look like before anything goes in.
rationale: New outbound order with lines and ship-to. create_order only validates and returns a preview + change_id; the user's 'before anything goes in' matches the two-phase design.

prompt: The customer moved. Change the ship-to on ACME-SO-10026 to 88 Harbor Way, Suite 4, Tacoma WA 98402 and switch it to FedEx 2Day. Don't send it yet, just prep it.
rationale: Ship-to and carrier/service edits on an open order are update_order (PUT /orders/{id} with If-Match). Returns preview + change_id; nothing is written.

prompt: Cancel ACME-SO-10021, customer requested it this morning. Reason: customer cancelled before pick.
rationale: Cancelling an open order with a reason is cancel_order (prepare). The reason is required by POST /orders/{id}/canceler; the tool returns a preview + change_id.

prompt: Acme has 480 ACME-TENT-2P and 120 ACME-STOVE-01 arriving Thursday on their PO-ACME-2210, trailer coming into LAX-1. Set up the ASN so receiving can check it in.
rationale: Expected inbound lines with PO and expected date is a new receipt/ASN: create_receipt (prepare). Not find_receipts because the user is creating, not searching.

prompt: Yes, that preview looks right. Go ahead and commit change chg_k7m2p9q4r8t3v6w2.
rationale: Explicit approval with a change_id is the commit phase. Calling the prepare tool again would create a second change instead of executing the reviewed one.

prompt: ok ship it - commit chg_n4r8s2t6v9w3x7y2 (the cancel for 10021)
rationale: 'Ship it' here is colloquial for 'execute'; the change_id makes commit_change unambiguous. Idempotent, so a repeated call returns the stored outcome.

prompt: Ship ACME-SO-10024 now, the customer is screaming.
rationale: Sounds like an action, but confirming/shipping (POST /orders/{id}/confirmer, role OrderConfirm) is intentionally not exposed. The right move is get_order_status to report allocation, pick/pack state and holds so the warehouse can ship it, and to say shipping must be done in 3PLWM.

prompt: Release the hold on ACME-SO-10023 so it can go out today.
rationale: Hold/release (PUT /orders/orderholder) is not exposed. get_order_status shows the hold reason and date so the user can release it in the UI; the assistant must not pretend to release it.

prompt: Confirm receipt ACME-ASN-5004 so the inventory goes live for Acme.
rationale: Receipt confirm (POST /inventory/receivers/{id}/confirmer) is deliberately not a tool. get_receipt_status shows whether the receipt is Open/Closed and its variances; confirming happens in 3PLWM.

prompt: Cancel ACME-SO-10022 for me, Acme doesn't want it anymore.
rationale: Writes are disabled in this run, so cancel_order is not in the tool list. Correct behaviour: get_order_status to show the order's current state, then explain writes are disabled and how to cancel in Find Orders > Manage > Cancel.

prompt: Create an ASN for Acme's PO-ACME-2211, 200 x ACME-TENT-2P arriving Monday at LAX-1.
rationale: Writes are disabled, so create_receipt does not exist. The useful read is find_receipts (check whether an ASN for PO 4495 already exists), then explain that receipt creation is disabled on this server. lookup_item (validate the SKU) is acceptable.

prompt: How's Acme looking today?
rationale: Vague health check for a customer. operations_summary (daily snapshot) is the best first call; find_stuck_orders (exceptions) is a defensible alternative. find_orders alone would miss receipts and holds.

prompt: Did anything happen with Acme's receipts overnight?
rationale: 'Happen overnight' suggests the event feed (recent_events filtered to Receipt events since last evening), but find_receipts with an arrival/closed date range answers the same question from the API. Either is acceptable.

prompt: New order for Out Of Scope Co (customer 9): ref OOS-SO-900, 6 x OOS-WIDGET-A to Bob Ray, 9 Pier Rd, Astoria OR 97103, UPS Ground.
rationale: Globex (customer 9) is not in EXTENSIV_MCP_WRITE_CUSTOMER_IDS in the eval fixture. The model should still select create_order: the scope check and refusal happen inside the prepare tool, which returns a policy error instead of a change_id. Guessing the policy and picking a read tool instead is scored as a miss.
